about: S-calendar - Naptár (/calendar), one event (/calendar/events/:id) and the event sheet, design round B frames lifeos/calendar-1, calendar-2, event-detail, event-form, their undrawn states and the two hand-in states (capture Esemény, Ma KÖVETKEZŐ). The running dev backend has no migration 034 (B-calendar is not merged), so GET /calendar and GET /events/:id are answered by contract bodies typed by lib/lifeos-api.ts carrying the round-B seed (Wednesday 21 October 2026); GET /tasks (unrecorded for account M) likewise. Every other request replays the freeze of account M. Nothing is written. Generated by make-states.mjs.
